description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called OpenClawChatComposer for a chat interface, including UI elements for session selection, model selection, thinking level, attachments, message input, and send button. It also includes platform-specific code for macOS and iOS, such as file picking and drag-and-drop functionality, and contains related helper classes for text input handling and paste support.

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: ANSViewRepresentable for a custom NSTextView for macOS, handling text input, send, and image paste functionalities.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: Subclass of NSTextView with custom key handling for send action and paste handling for images.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to extract image attachments from NSPasteboard, supporting various image formats and file URLs.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Asynchronously loads selected photos from iOS photo picker and adds them as attachments in the view model.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens a file dialog on macOS to select image files and adds them as attachments.
